About

Design is not just what I do.
It's how I communicate ideas.

Hi, I'm P.D. Yadeesha Shen Perera. With 3+ years of experience in graphic design, I focus on crafting distinct visual identities and engaging design solutions. I blend thoughtful aesthetics with functional layout to build memorable brand experiences that resonate with people.

Services

What I Can Do For Your Brand

01

Brand Identity

Building memorable brands through creative logos, visual identities, and consistent design systems.

02

Social Media Design

Creating eye-catching social media visuals that capture attention and keep your brand engaging.

03

YouTube Thumbnails

Designing high-impact thumbnails that grab attention, increase clicks, and make your content stand out.

04

T-Shirt Design

Creating bold and creative T-shirt designs for brands, events, teams, and personal collections.

05

UI/UX Design

Designing clean and modern interfaces focused on usability, visual appeal, and seamless experiences.

06

Process

How I Turn Ideas Into Design

  1. 01

    Discover

    Understand the brand, audience and objective.

  2. 02

    Research

    Explore references, competitors, trends and visual directions.

  3. 03

    Concept

    Develop creative concepts and visual directions.

  4. 04

    Design

    Transform the concept into polished visual assets.

  5. 05

    Refine

    Review, improve and perfect every detail.

  6. 06

    Deliver

    Provide final professional assets ready for use.
